instructions:
1. Stand sideways beside an agility ladder laid flat on the floor.
2. Step both feet into the first square one at a time (in, in).
3. Step both feet out to the side of the next square one at a time (out, out).
4. Continue the in-in-out-out pattern while moving laterally down the ladder.
5. Stay low, keep quick light ground contacts, and face the same direction.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stay on the balls of your feet for fast, light contacts.
2. Keep knees bent and hips low to control lateral movement.
3. Brace your core to resist twisting as you shuffle sideways.
4. Keep your chest up and look ahead, not down at your feet.

instructions:
1. Stand facing an agility ladder laid flat on the floor.
2. Step both feet into the first square one at a time (in, in).
3. Step both feet out and forward straddling the next square (out, out).
4. Drive one knee up high with each step to add a knee lift.
5. Continue the pattern moving forward down the ladder with quick contacts.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the knee up to hip height with each lift.
2. Stay on the balls of your feet for quick ground contacts.
3. Keep your torso tall and core braced throughout.
4. Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs for balance.

instructions:
1. Stand sideways beside an agility ladder laid flat on the floor.
2. Step both feet into the first square one at a time (in, in).
3. Step the lead foot out to the side of the next square (out).
4. Continue the in-in-out pattern while moving laterally down the ladder.
5. Stay low with quick light contacts and face the same direction.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stay on the balls of your feet for fast lateral steps.
2. Keep knees bent and hips low to control side movement.
3. Brace your core to resist twisting as you shuffle.

instructions:
1. Stand sideways beside an agility ladder laid flat on the floor.
2. Hop both feet into the first square, then hop in place a second time (double hop).
3. Hop both feet laterally into the next square and double hop again.
4. Continue hopping sideways down the ladder, one square at a time.
5. Land softly on the balls of your feet and stay low.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Land softly through the balls of your feet to absorb impact.
2. Keep knees bent to cushion each hop.
3. Drive off both feet evenly for balanced lateral hops.
4. Brace your core to stay controlled between squares.
